gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-chocolate-classi: Chocolate Classical Sans reads with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. Stencilia takes the structural, striking part up top, so the body text can go a touch larger without crowding it.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-comme: Comme reads as a smooth, modern plain sans, its curves never clogging and its lowercase filling most of the letter height. Stencilia's gappy display letters sit above it.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte has wide-eyed lowercase e shapes and a prominent x-height, with arches as thick as the stems beside them, unlike Stencilia's low contrast. Paragraphs of it move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-fresca: Stencilia is structural and striking, with spacious gaps at its curve terminals and a compact gap under the ascender line. Fresca follows like a letter bent from a single wire, keeping its counters open to the outside.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans has tiny gaps between ascender tops and the x-height line, plus a lowercase e opened like a pried clasp. Its t keeps crossbar and stem matched, which settles the page under Stencilia.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-gafata: Gafata stacks a tall band of letters under short stalks, with each lowercase e looking wide-eyed and friendly. Pages of it stay comfortable, a steady contemporary hum beneath Stencilia's striking display.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat, with no accents of weight and words that read as solid blocks. Stencilia handles striking structure at the top, while Geist does the steady, joined-up work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-georama: Wide-open and approachable, that's the body here. Georama's c looks like a bracelet pulled apart, and its barely rising capitals sit comfortably beneath Stencilia's structural, striking display letters.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-gidole: Stencilia brings spacious curve gaps and a compact band under its ascenders, low in contrast and strikingly built. Gidole follows with neon-tube consistency in every stroke, its terminals staying apart like open scissor blades.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-golos-text: Approachable and contemporary, the body leans on an x-height that fills the line and a widely parted s. Golos Text lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, the perfect foil for Stencilia's structure.
